sheet.title: A square sheet
sheet.instruction: Place a square with a straight edge at the top. The top half will become the head.
sheet.result: One flat square has four free corners.

double-the-square.title: Narrow the square
double-the-square.instruction: Fold both side edges in to meet on the vertical centerline.
double-the-square.result: A double-thickness strip is twice as tall as it is wide.

mark-first-diagonal.title: Mark the first diagonal
mark-first-diagonal.instruction: Fold the upper left corner across the top square to the opposite lower corner of that square.
mark-first-diagonal.result: The crease runs from its lower left to upper right.

open-first-diagonal.title: Open the first diagonal
open-first-diagonal.instruction: Return the corner to the top without opening the long side folds.
open-first-diagonal.result: A diagonal remains in the top square.

mark-second-diagonal.title: Mark the second diagonal
mark-second-diagonal.instruction: Fold the upper right corner to the lower left corner of the same square.
mark-second-diagonal.result: The second diagonal crosses the first.

open-second-diagonal.title: Open the second diagonal
open-second-diagonal.instruction: Lift the corner back into place.

mark-head-cross.title: Reverse the cross crease
mark-head-cross.instruction: Fold the top edge behind the strip through the center of the X.
mark-head-cross.result: The top edge meets the bottom of the head square.

open-head-cross.title: Open the cross crease
open-head-cross.instruction: Return the top edge to its starting position.
open-head-cross.result: A crosswise ridge passes through the X.

collapse-head.title: Collapse the head
collapse-head.instruction: Hold the lower triangle still. Push the side midpoints inward and let the upper triangle come down over them.
collapse-head.result: Two folded pockets lie between the triangular covers.

raise-front-feet.title: Raise the front feet
raise-front-feet.instruction: Take the two loose corners of the upper triangle up to its apex. Leave the lower triangle against the body.
raise-front-feet.result: Two tips meet at the nose.

splay-front-feet.title: Open the front stance
splay-front-feet.instruction: From the center of the triangle base, crease to the midpoint of each raised flap’s outer slope. Turn just its tip outward.
splay-front-feet.result: Two front feet point to either side of the nose.

double-the-tail.title: Double the tail
double-the-tail.instruction: Bring the bottom edge up to the base of the head.
double-the-tail.result: The lower body has a doubled straight edge.

narrow-waist.title: Narrow the waist
narrow-waist.instruction: Bring the body edges to the center under the free front feet. Include the lower head plies attached to those edges.
narrow-waist.result: A narrow waist sits below the shoulders.

roll-rear-edge.title: Roll up the rear edge
roll-rear-edge.instruction: Bring the doubled rear edge up to the triangle base again.
roll-rear-edge.result: A short, thick rectangle rests across the waist.

mark-pockets.title: Mark the pocket hinges
mark-pockets.instruction: On the raised rectangle fold its two upper corners down to the center of its lower edge.
mark-pockets.result: Two small triangles meet between the hind legs.

open-pocket-marks.title: Release the pocket marks
open-pocket-marks.instruction: Open just those two triangles, keeping the rear edge folded up.
open-pocket-marks.result: The two diagonals locate the mouths of the pockets.

spread-hind-pockets.title: Spread the hind pockets
spread-hind-pockets.instruction: Hold the inner diagonal of each pocket. Lift the buried rim and ease its loose corner sideways until the pocket flattens.
spread-hind-pockets.result: The rear flap widens into a boat shape with a point on each side.

angle-hind-feet.title: Angle the hind feet
angle-hind-feet.instruction: From the middle of the long boat edge, crease toward a point two thirds down each sloping side. Fold the free tips toward the tail.
angle-hind-feet.result: Four distinct feet surround the belly.

double-the-spring.title: Double the spring
double-the-spring.instruction: Lift the whole tail and hind feet over the waist along the base of the head.
double-the-spring.result: The rear packet doubles onto the belly.

return-the-pleat.title: Return the pleat
return-the-pleat.instruction: Bend the hind feet back across the middle of the doubled waist, leaving the return about thirty degrees open.
return-the-pleat.result: The folded-back tail forms the second bend of a Z.

ease-the-spring.title: Ease the spring
ease-the-spring.instruction: Open the first bend slightly, keeping the return crease and both hind feet together.
ease-the-spring.result: The head, four feet and a raised spring are visible. The model shows the resting fold.
